text: Power engineering and thermophysics is a discipline that studies the fundamental theories and engineering applications of energy conversion, transmission and utilization. Its core focuses on the conversion laws of "thermal energy - mechanical energy - electrical energy", addressing issues such as efficient energy utilization, optimization of power systems and design of thermal equipment. As a typical interdisciplinary field, its research scope covers traditional energy (thermal power, nuclear power), new energy (wind power, hydrogen energy), energy-saving technologies (energy storage, heat pumps), and aerospace power (aero engines), among others. It serves as a technical pillar for industries such as energy, transportation, and manufacturing in the national economy.
